cues.en: All right, we are finally going to start having some fun.
cues.zh: 好，終於要開始玩一些更有趣的功能了。

cues.en: We're going to try to do now agent framework with actually Microsoft Foundry itself, which is very interesting in how to do that and how to instantiate the project in the Foundry itself
cues.zh: 這次要把 Agent Framework 和 Microsoft Foundry 本身整合，看看如何在 Foundry 裡建立專案相關物件，

cues.en: to create the agent based on that.
cues.zh: 並以此建立代理程式。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and show you how to do this.
cues.zh: 現在來示範。

cues.en: All right, we are in Visual Studio Code.
cues.zh: 這裡是 Visual Studio Code，

cues.en: I already created the project, so I don't waste time.
cues.zh: 專案已經先建立好，避免浪費時間，

cues.en: You already know how to do that several times.
cues.zh: 你也已經看過很多次建立方式。

cues.en: But the project here has no NuGet packages yet.
cues.zh: 不過專案還沒有 NuGet 套件，

cues.en: Let me go ahead and add my NuGet packages.
cues.zh: 先把所需套件加進來。

cues.en: This one has a little bit more than usual because we're bringing in the Microsoft Foundry as well.
cues.zh: 這次比平常多一些，因為也需要 Microsoft Foundry。

cues.en: So you probably used to see this one at the bottom in here.
cues.zh: 下面這個套件應該已經很熟悉，

cues.en: Based on this morning, we have the 1.1.
cues.zh: 今天早上更新到了 1.1，

cues.en: By the time you get this, it will probably be a completely different version, but hopefully it will work the same.
cues.zh: 你看到時，版本也許完全不同，但希望做法仍然相同。

cues.en: But we're bringing in the Microsoft Agent AI OpenAI.
cues.zh: 這裡加入 Microsoft.Agents.AI.OpenAI，

cues.en: You've seen this one also, the one before last.
cues.zh: 倒數第二個你也看過，

cues.en: That is the one responsible for the Microsoft Foundry.
cues.zh: 它負責 Microsoft Foundry 的相關功能，

cues.en: I'm also bringing in the Microsoft Agent AI Foundry 1.1 as well.
cues.zh: 另外也加入 Microsoft.Agents.AI.Foundry 1.1。

cues.en: I need to bring in azure.identity so I can log in to the Microsoft Foundry using my credential.
cues.zh: 需要 Azure.Identity，才能使用自己的認證登入 Microsoft Foundry。

cues.en: Hopefully you will have Azure CLI installed.
cues.zh: 希望你已經安裝 Azure CLI，

cues.en: You will do an AZ login here in the terminal to make sure that you're logged in to your subscription that has access to Microsoft Foundry.
cues.zh: 在終端機執行 az login，確認登入具有 Foundry 存取權的訂閱。

cues.en: All right, and then we also have the most important part, which is the Azure AI projects.
cues.zh: 另外最重要的是 Azure.AI.Projects，

cues.en: This is the one responsible for talking directly to the project in the Microsoft Foundry itself.
cues.zh: 它負責直接和 Microsoft Foundry 裡的專案通訊。

cues.en: So these are the five NuGet packages that you should actually run by copy and pasting these five lines or by right-clicking in here and say add NuGet packages
cues.zh: 所以需要這五個 NuGet 套件，可以複製這五行，或按右鍵選 Add NuGet Packages，

cues.en: and then just copy each and every single one of the names as well. Sounds good?
cues.zh: 再逐一貼上名稱加入，明白嗎？

cues.en: So that's the first piece.
cues.zh: 這是第一部分。

cues.en: Let's go ahead and save all of this, and then we'll go ahead to the program.
cues.zh: 儲存全部內容，再進到 Program，

cues.en: We'll delete all of this from here, and let me bring in the code that I'll need to explain to you right now.
cues.zh: 刪掉這些預設程式，貼上接著要說明的程式碼。

cues.en: All right, and do a Control V, and let me explain what's happening here.
cues.zh: 按 Ctrl+V，現在解釋這裡發生什麼。

cues.en: First of all, the first object here is very important, the AI project client.
cues.zh: 首先，第一個物件非常重要，是 AIProjectClient，

cues.en: This guy is coming in from the Azure AI project agent's namespace.
cues.zh: 來自 Azure AI Projects 相關的命名空間。

cues.en: So this is how we specify to the system where the client is going to be coming from.
cues.zh: 藉此告訴系統，要使用哪種用戶端。

cues.en: So I need to put here a full project UR endpoint.
cues.zh: 這裡需要完整的 Project URI 端點，

cues.en: So remember, my user secrets have the wrong endpoint.
cues.zh: 所以記得，之前 User Secrets 裡的端點在這個情境不適用，

cues.en: My endpoint ended at services.ai.azure.com.
cues.zh: 原本只到 services.ai.azure.com，

cues.en: No, this one, if you're going to use the AI project client, it needs to be the full line.
cues.zh: 但使用 AIProjectClient，必須提供完整路徑。

cues.en: So let me show you where that is.
cues.zh: 來看看在哪裡，

cues.en: So I'm going to go back to home in here, and this is the project endpoint completely.
cues.zh: 回到首頁，這就是完整的 Project Endpoint，

cues.en: So I'm going to copy this into the clipboard, and we'll come back in here, and I'm going to change this part to show you exactly what's going on.
cues.zh: 複製到剪貼簿，再回來修改這一段，讓你看得清楚。

cues.en: See, when we did the user secret earlier when I wanted to work with the open AI inside of Microsoft Foundry, I stopped right before the word API.
cues.zh: 前面設定使用者秘密、要從 Foundry 直接使用 OpenAI 時，端點停在 API 之前，

cues.en: But now I need the AI project client.
cues.zh: 但現在使用的是 AIProjectClient，

cues.en: That means I need the whole thing.
cues.zh: 就需要完整內容，

cues.en: I need the agent framework core service.ai.azure.com plus API projects and the name of the project as well.
cues.zh: 包含 Agent Framework 資源的 services.ai.azure.com，加上 /api/projects/ 和專案名稱。

cues.en: I'm going to be using the credentials from Azure CLI credential.
cues.zh: 認證使用 AzureCliCredential，

cues.en: That's why you need to do an AZ client in your terminal for this to work first.
cues.zh: 所以前面必須先在終端機執行 az login，才能運作。

cues.en: And then there are two things that we need to go through.
cues.zh: 接著有兩件事情要處理，

cues.en: The first one, I'm going to create the options.
cues.zh: 第一，先建立選項，

cues.en: Remember, we always created an agent, and we can pass it options, like we did in previous examples.
cues.zh: 前面建立代理程式時，都可以傳入選項，

cues.en: So I'm going to create the options first, and it has to do with objects called projects, agent, version, creation, options in here.
cues.zh: 這裡也先建立選項，使用 ProjectAgentVersionCreationOptions 這類物件。

cues.en: The main thing that I'm trying to do is I'm going to try to do two things, pass you the model and pass you the instructions.
cues.zh: 主要是提供兩件事：模型，以及指示。

cues.en: There are other things that you can do, like temperature and top P and top K and things like that.
cues.zh: 當然還能設定 Temperature、Top P、Top K 等等，

cues.en: But I just wanted to tell you the options that I'm interested in using GPT-5 mini, and the instructions are simple as possible.
cues.zh: 不過目前只需要告訴它，使用 GPT-5 mini，指示也盡量簡單，

cues.en: You are a helpful assistant, and that's it.
cues.zh: 就是「你是一個樂於助人的助理」。

cues.en: But, of course, I'm counting on you to be very creative and create some amazing things in here.
cues.zh: 當然，也期待你發揮創意，創造更棒的應用，

cues.en: Sometimes the instruction is almost like two pages long to explain exactly how you want the system to work.
cues.zh: 有時候指示甚至有兩頁長，精確解釋希望系統如何運作，

cues.en: But this is just a demo to show you how to create the options.
cues.zh: 但這裡只是示範如何建立選項。

cues.en: And now I'm definitely needing to create the project agent version.
cues.zh: 接著，需要建立 Project Agent Version，

cues.en: And it's important.
cues.zh: 這點很重要，

cues.en: This was not always the case during the previews with the release candidate.
cues.zh: 早期預覽版、候選發布版不一定這樣做，

cues.en: This has changed so much in the last few months before the product went into GA.
cues.zh: 在正式發布前幾個月，介面變動非常多。

cues.en: Now everything has a version number, so I can actually change the version from version 1 to 2 to 3 to 4.
cues.zh: 現在所有代理程式都有版本號，可以從第一版變成第二、第三、第四版，

cues.en: It used to be based on an asset ID, which is a GUID.
cues.zh: 以前則是以 Asset ID，也就是 Guid 識別，

cues.en: It is no longer the case.
cues.zh: 現在已經不是這樣，

cues.en: Everything is recognized by the name.
cues.zh: 而是透過名稱辨識。

cues.en: So I'm creating an agent in here, using the client.AgentAdministrationClient.CreateAgentVersionAsync, and I'm saying an agent.
cues.zh: 這裡用 client.AgentAdministrationClient.CreateAgentVersionAsync，建立代理程式，

cues.en: Notice I did not pass here like version 1 or version 2.
cues.zh: 注意沒有指定第一版或第二版，

cues.en: If the agent doesn't exist, it will automatically be version 1.
cues.zh: 如果代理程式還不存在，就會自動建立第一版，

cues.en: If I'm trying to create another agent, my agent, and it found that there is a version 1, the new one will be version 2 because it has exactly the same name.
cues.zh: 如果相同名稱 My Agent 已經有第一版，再建立時就會變成第二版。

cues.en: So there is no IDs like before the product was released.
cues.zh: 因此不像產品正式發布前那樣，主要依靠 ID，

cues.en: So put that in mind as well.
cues.zh: 這一點要記住。

cues.en: So this line in here will use the client that I created earlier.
cues.zh: 這行會使用剛才建立的用戶端，

cues.en: It will create something called my agent.
cues.zh: 建立名為 My Agent 的代理程式，

cues.en: You can choose whatever name for your agent that you want.
cues.zh: 當然名稱可以自行決定，

cues.en: And I pass it the options that tell it that I'm using GPT-5 mini, and this is the instruction for that agent. Great.
cues.zh: 再傳入選項，告訴它使用 GPT-5 mini，以及這段指示。很好。

cues.en: So now we're ready to use that agent.
cues.zh: 現在才準備好使用代理程式，

cues.en: This is just the creation of the agent.
cues.zh: 前面只是建立，

cues.en: You now need to go ahead and use it.
cues.zh: 接下來還要真正使用它。

cues.en: Why is that different thing between creation and using?
cues.zh: 為什麼要把建立和使用分開？

cues.en: Because that was not a problem before.
cues.zh: 前面似乎沒有這個問題，

cues.en: Remember that you can go to the Microsoft Foundry and you can create an agent visually over there, right?
cues.zh: 記得，你也可以在 Microsoft Foundry 裡，用視覺化介面建立代理程式，

cues.en: So you might create, let's say, an agent called the Lino agent, okay, visually without writing any code.
cues.zh: 例如不寫程式，直接建立一個 Lino Agent，

cues.en: So you don't need to do this part.
cues.zh: 那就不需要這一段建立程式碼，

cues.en: You just need to go ahead and create an object of type Foundry agent, and then you can tell it which one you want by passing it the name of the agent itself because it already exists.
cues.zh: 只要建立 FoundryAgent 物件，再傳入代理程式名稱，指定要使用已存在的哪一個。

cues.en: I would say in real life you will always find yourself creating the agents in code, and by the time the application runs, maybe there is a reason for you to keep it, maybe there is a reason for you to delete it,
cues.zh: 實務上，你可能仍然經常透過程式建立代理程式，應用程式執行結束時，也許需要保留，也許需要刪除，

cues.en: so it will never persist in the Microsoft agent.
cues.zh: 避免它一直保存在 Foundry 裡，

cues.en: So put that in mind as well.
cues.zh: 也要記得這一點。

cues.en: Anyway, now that we've created one in the Foundry, I'm going to go ahead and use the Foundry agent.
cues.zh: 總之，在 Foundry 建立完成後，接著使用 FoundryAgent，

cues.en: Even that part changed a lot during the previews and the release candidate, and right before the agent framework went to release, there is the new object in here called Foundry agent.
cues.zh: 這部分在預覽、候選版本到正式發布前也改過很多次，現在有 FoundryAgent 這個新的物件。

cues.en: Give it a name, and then we'll say client.asAIAgent and pass the name of the agent or the object of the agent right here, which is the project agent version, all right?
cues.zh: 設定名稱，再呼叫 client.AsAIAgent，傳入代理程式名稱，或這裡的 ProjectAgentVersion 物件。

cues.en: From that point on, and this is still even after the product went into GA, there will be some changes in this in the future as well, so keep that in mind as well because not everything is in GA.
cues.zh: 即使產品已經正式發布，這部分未來也可能繼續變更，因為不是所有套件都已正式發布，

cues.en: Some of these things are still in preview.
cues.zh: 有些仍處於預覽階段。

cues.en: Remember, in .NET, for instance, there is 28 packages that are part of the agent framework.
cues.zh: 例如 .NET 的 Agent Framework，總共有 28 個套件，

cues.en: Only six of them are in GA.
cues.zh: 其中只有六個正式發布，

cues.en: There are 22 different packages that are still in preview even after the product went into GA.
cues.zh: 即使主產品 GA，仍有 22 個套件處於預覽，

cues.en: Put that in mind as well.
cues.zh: 這一點也要記住。

cues.en: So this is how we deal with the Microsoft Foundation.
cues.zh: 以上就是和 Microsoft Foundation；

cues.en: I'm sorry, the Microsoft Foundry, in case we have already agents built there or you would like to create it and put it in the Microsoft Foundry and then start using it again.
cues.zh: 更正，是 Microsoft Foundry 互動的方式，可以使用其中已有的代理程式，也可以建立後放到 Foundry，再取出使用。

cues.en: But again, like I said before, from that point on, everything is the same, right?
cues.zh: 但如前面說過，從這裡開始，其他內容都一樣，

cues.en: So I'm going to start my stopwatch.
cues.zh: 一樣啟動 Stopwatch，

cues.en: I'm going to run a sync with my question.
cues.zh: 透過 RunAsync 提出問題，

cues.en: All the users for the response is the same.
cues.zh: 回應的 Usage 用法也相同。

cues.en: So it's only during the creation of the client and the agent that things might be different, but from that point on, everything will be identical to all of them.
cues.zh: 所以差異只在建立用戶端和代理程式的階段，之後所有供應商的操作都一樣。

cues.en: All right, let me go ahead and save this file, and we'll go ahead and cd into my Foundry demo, and let's see if this will work for us.
cues.zh: 先儲存檔案，cd 到 Foundry Demo，看看是否能成功執行，

cues.en: We'll say .NET run. All right.
cues.zh: 輸入 dotnet run，

cues.en: And again, what's happening right now is that it's connecting to the Microsoft Foundry using my credentials.
cues.zh: 目前正在使用我的認證連到 Microsoft Foundry，

cues.en: It's actually creating some options for GPT-5 mini with the instructions.
cues.zh: 建立 GPT-5 mini 與指示的選項，

cues.en: It's creating a brand new agent. It's called my agent.
cues.zh: 建立新的 My Agent，

cues.en: And now we're going to go ahead and create an instance of the Foundry agent, and we're going to run it with the Y is the sky blue against that as well. All right?
cues.zh: 再建立 FoundryAgent 執行個體，向它詢問「天空為什麼是藍色的？」。

cues.en: So this could be actually one of the 11,500 models available in the Microsoft Foundry, if you'd like, so you can change that GPT-5 mini to any of them, as long as you have deployed it in your project already,
cues.zh: 這裡其實可以改成 Foundry 裡 11,500 個模型中的其他模型，只要先在專案部署，就能把 GPT-5 mini 替換，

cues.en: and that will work just fine.
cues.zh: 一樣正常運作。

cues.en: All right, and it came back.
cues.zh: 答案回來了，

cues.en: It looks like it got the answer correct.
cues.zh: 看起來答對了，

cues.en: There is 22 tokens for the input, 0 cache, 618 output, and there is 320 reasoning because GPT-5 mini is a reasoning model as well.
cues.zh: 輸入 22 個 Token、快取零、輸出 618，其中推理是 320，因為 GPT-5 mini 也是推理模型，

cues.en: The total was 640, and it took about 18 and a half seconds to come back.
cues.zh: 總計 640 個，回應花了大約十八秒半。

cues.en: And that is something Microsoft is still working on as well to make the Microsoft Foundry going back and forth much, much faster, but we will be able to make it faster as well on our side into the future.
cues.zh: 微軟也在持續改善 Foundry 的來回速度，後面我們也能從程式端做一些優化，

cues.en: But this is how easy it is to use agent framework with an agent that needs to be created and retrieved from Microsoft Foundry itself.
cues.zh: 不過以上就是利用 Agent Framework，建立並取回 Microsoft Foundry 代理程式的方式。

cues.en: Before, we were going against the model directly, whether it's Entropic or Google or Mistral and all of these, but this one is getting the agent, creating the agent
cues.zh: 前面是直接連到模型，例如 Anthropic、Google、Mistral；這次則是建立代理程式，

cues.en: and getting the agent directly from the Microsoft Foundry.
cues.zh: 再直接從 Microsoft Foundry 取得它。

cues.en: Hopefully, this was useful, and I'll see you again in the next video. Thank you.
cues.zh: 希望對你有幫助，下段影片見，謝謝。
